svg.title: The old conversion-test cycle
svg.desc: Four steps in a loop: a conversion manager has an idea, a designer mocks it up, a developer builds it once a sprint has room, the conversion manager runs the live test, and the learnings feed the next idea. The developer step is circled as the bottleneck. Idea to live test took up to two weeks.
svg.text: up to 2 weeks, idea to live test
